transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some issues with... eating. After my cashier shifts, I kind of... I keep buying these really huge takeout orders. Just, a lot of food. Like... burgers, fries, chicken, desserts... probably enough for a whole family. And I'll just sit there and... eat almost all of it by myself before I even go home. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you feel guilty after eating these large amounts of food by yourself?
Um... yeah. I guess I do. I just... I try not to think about it too much afterwards.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating these large amounts of food?
No. I... I don't do that.
Do you ever exercise excessively to try to burn off the calories from these large meals?
No. I don't really... exercise. Not really.
How often do you find yourself eating these large amounts of food by yourself?

Um... I guess... a lot. For the last few months, it's been maybe... three or four nights most weeks. I don't know. Just... ever since the foreclosure calls started, I can't really remember a week where I didn't do it at least once.
When you're eating these large amounts of food, do you feel like you're unable to stop or control how much you're eating?

Yeah... I guess. It's like... once I take that first bite, it feels like something in me just clicks off. I'll be sitting there telling myself, 'Demetrius, stop, you don’t need any more'... but... I don't know. My hands just keep reaching for the next thing anyway. I just... I can't stop it.
Do you usually eat these large amounts of food when you're feeling stressed or upset, like with the foreclosure calls?
I don't really know. Um... maybe. I don't really pay attention to how I'm feeling right before. I'm just... always stressed right now, so... I don't know if that's why. I just do it.
Do you think eating these large amounts of food helps you feel better when you're stressed or upset?
Um... I don't know. Not really, I guess. I don't really feel better. I just... I don't really think about it like that.
Do you think eating these large amounts of food is a way for you to deal with your stress or emotions?
Um... I don't really know. Like I said, I'm not... I don't really look at it like that. I'm not doing it on purpose to fix my emotions or anything. I just... I just eat.
Do you think there's a connection between how you're feeling and when you decide to buy and eat these large amounts of food?
I mean... I guess not. I don't really see a connection. Like I said, I'm just stressed all the time, so... it's just something I do. I don't really think about it.
Do you think your eating large amounts of food is related to trying to cope with your emotions?
I... I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing. I already said, I don't think so. I'm not... trying to cope with anything. I just eat.
Do you experience a loss of control and rapid consumption of food during these episodes of eating large amounts?

Yeah, I guess. Um... it's just, once I take that first bite, it's like... I don't know, something in me just clicks off. Even if I'm sitting there telling myself, like, 'Demetrius, stop, you don't need any more'... my hands just keep reaching for the next thing anyway. It just happens fast.
Do you enjoy the taste or experience of eating during these episodes?
I don't really know. Um... I don't really taste it, I guess. I'm just eating.
How many times a week do you typically eat these large amounts of food by yourself?

Um... I guess for the last few months, maybe... three or four nights most weeks. I don't really keep track. But... yeah, I don't think there's been a week where it didn't happen at least once... not since those foreclosure calls started, anyway.
Do you feel any pleasure while eating these large amounts of food?
Um... I mean, like I just said... no. Not really. It's not... it's not fun or anything. I don't really feel much at all.
Do you ever feel an intense sense of pleasure or a high during these episodes of eating large amounts of food?
No. Um... like I just said, I don't feel any pleasure. Definitely no high or anything like that. I just... I just do it.
Do you think your stress or emotional state has anything to do with when these episodes of eating large amounts of food happen?
Um... I don't know. I guess. I don't really... I don't sit around thinking about my emotions or anything like that. It just happens.
How many times a month would you say you have one of these episodes of eating a large amount of food by yourself?

Um... I don't know the exact number for a whole month. Just... lately, for the last few months, it's been maybe three or four nights most weeks. I guess... I can't really think of a week where it didn't happen at least once. Not since those foreclosure calls started, anyway.
